stickytoggle.message.not_available: Alloy Sticky Toggle 2.2 isn't on this server, so there is nothing to change here. Your settings live on the server.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockSlime:
All slime effects for you: bounce, walk slowdown and slipperiness.
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockHoney:
All honey effects for you: speed, jump and wall slide.
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockSoulSan:
All soul sand effects for you: slowdown.
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockIce:
All ice effects for you: slipperiness (ice, packed ice, blue ice, frosted ice).
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockCobweb:
All cobweb effects for you: slowdown.
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockPowderS:
All powder snow effects for you: slowdown (you still freeze).
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockBerryBu:
All sweet berry bush effects for you: slowdown (thorns still hurt).
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockWater:
All water current effects for you: push from flowing water (swimming stays normal).
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockBubbleC:
All bubble column effects for you: push up and pull down.
OFF = acts like a normal block, for you only. ON = vanilla.
The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.blockAll:
Every setting of every block at once, for you only.
Shows ON only while every setting is on.
stickytoggle.config.comment.slime_bounce:
ON: bounce when landing on slime.
OFF: land like on a normal block.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.slime_walkSl:
ON: slowed while walking on slime.
OFF: normal walking speed.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.slime_slippe:
ON: slime is slippery (0.8).
OFF: no slide (0.6).
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.honey_veloci:
ON: movement x0.4 on honey.
OFF: normal speed.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.honey_jumpMu:
ON: jump height x0.5 on honey.
OFF: normal jump.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.honey_wallSl:
ON: slow slide down honey walls.
OFF: fall past them at normal speed (fall distance is still reset).
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.soulsand_slo:
ON: movement x0.4 on soul sand.
OFF: normal speed.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.ice_slipperi:
ON: ice slides (0.98, blue ice 0.989).
OFF: no slide (0.6).
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.cobweb_slowd:
ON: nearly stuck in cobwebs.
OFF: move through them at normal speed.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.powderSnow_s:
ON: slowed inside powder snow.
OFF: normal speed. Freezing stays vanilla.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.berryBush_sl:
ON: slowed in sweet berry bushes.
OFF: normal speed. Thorns still hurt.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.water_curren:
ON: flowing water pushes you.
OFF: not pushed. Swimming, floating and lava are unchanged.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.bubbleColumn:
ON: soul sand columns lift you, magma columns pull you down.
OFF: acts like still water.
Only changes you. The hotkey (unbound by default) flips it.
stickytoggle.config.comment.openConfigMe: Opens this menu. Unbound by default.
